metadata.description: DSPy.ts Claude Code & Codex plugins — program AI systems on AgentDB. From practical (scaffold/compile/eval) to exotic (GEPA self-evolution) plus vertical appliances.

plugins.name: dspy-core
plugins.description: Scaffold, compile (BootstrapFewShot/MIPROv2/GEPA) and evaluate DSPy.ts programs; the `dspy-architect` agent designs signatures, modules and metrics.

plugins.name: dspy-optimize
plugins.description: Deep optimizer workflows: MIPROv2 + experience replay, GEPA Pareto evolution, BootstrapFewShot dynamic demos; `optimizer-engineer` agent.

plugins.name: dspy-rag
plugins.description: RAG with `RetrieveModule` over AgentDB (HNSW, RaBitQ, MMR) wired into ChainOfThought; `rag-architect` agent; corpus-indexing commands.

plugins.name: dspy-react
plugins.description: ReAct agents with tool registries + `ReActReflexion` (recall lessons, record episodes, promote skills); `react-engineer` agent.

plugins.name: dspy-observability
plugins.description: `CompilationTracer` causal-chain traces, AgentDB persistence, optional MLflow; `CachingLM` setup; `observability-engineer` agent.

plugins.name: dspy-evolution
plugins.description: Exotic: GEPA-driven self-evolution loops that optimize a program's prompts (and the program itself) against a benchmark across runs; `evolution-coordinator` agent.

plugins.name: dspy-appliance-support-bot
plugins.description: Vertical appliance: a pre-wired DSPy.ts support assistant — RAG over a knowledge base + ChainOfThought answer + a quality metric + MIPROv2 tuning.

plugins.name: dspy-appliance-code-review
plugins.description: Vertical appliance: a DSPy.ts code-review pipeline — Retrieve(repo context) → ChainOfThought(review) → metric on actionability; GEPA-tuned.

plugins.name: dspy-appliance-research-assistant
plugins.description: Vertical appliance: a DSPy.ts research assistant — ReAct(search tools)+reflexion → synthesize → cite; optimized for grounded answers.

plugins.name: dspy-appliance-data-pipeline
plugins.description: Vertical appliance: a DSPy.ts ETL/classification pipeline — typed Predict modules in a Pipeline, BootstrapFewShot from a labeled CSV, evaluated batch.
